subject: general
question: ________ city has emerged as the 'Silicon Valley of India'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bengaluru city has emerged as the 'Silicon Valley of India'.**
 
• It is called so because of the number of IT companies and start-ups emerging from the city.
 
• Bengaluru is the capital city of Karnataka and is located on the mysuru plateau.
 
• It is also called 'the electronics city of India'
 
• It ranks 3rd in the number of start-ups emerging globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The IT sector in India contributed about 8% to Indian GDP in 2017.
 
• Texas instrument was the first MNC to start a development center in Bengaluru.
 
• Pune is called 'the oxford of east'.
 
• Chennai is called Detroit of Asia, the Healthcare capital of India
